units: <cite ref="Shabbat 141a:17">Sabb. 141ᵃ</cite> <he>לא לִיהֲדוֹק וכ׳</he> one must not squeeze cotton into the mouth of a bottle (as a stopper).
B. Kam. 85ᵇ דהַדְּקֵיח, v. הַרְזֵיק.—Part. pass. מְהַדַּק, v. infra.
<cite ref="Shabbat 65a:6">Sabb. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>הא דמִיהֲדַק</he> ed. (Ar. <he>מְהַדַּק</he>, v. supra) in the one case it means that it is squeezed into the ear.
<cite ref="Pesachim 109b">Pes. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>הַדּוּקֵי חוח מיהדק</he> the parts of the table were rabbeted.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 31a:10">Ab. Zar. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>דיקולא ומי׳</he> a basket squeezed over the wine casket.
